# AI Agent Crypto — Autonomous On-Chain Agents Reference

> What AI agents in crypto are — autonomous on-chain agents, agent frameworks and wallets for agents — plus common use-cases and the key risks. Educational and neutral, not affiliated with any project. Not financial advice.

## Key Facts
- AI agent (crypto): software using AI to make decisions and act autonomously on a blockchain (wallet, reads state, sends transactions)
- Defining trait: autonomy within owner-set limits; decision layer usually off-chain, action layer on-chain
- Agent frameworks: toolkits wiring a model, memory, tools and blockchain connectors; vary in maturity/audit status
- Agent wallets: keys an agent can sign with, bounded by spending limits, allowlists, session keys or smart-contract accounts
- Use-cases: automated trading/rebalancing, monitoring, DeFi automation, social bots, multi-step workflows
- Risks: autonomous irreversible actions, key compromise, prompt injection/bad data, unaudited code, hype and scam tokens
- Neutral educational overview — NOT affiliated with or endorsing any project or token
